summary: Delek Logistics Partners, LP filed an 8-K announcing the commencement of a tender offer for any and all of its outstanding 7.125% Senior Notes due 2028, alongside a private offering of $800 million in new senior notes due 2034. The tender offer targets existing debt, with terms including the specific notes and an expectation to fund the purchase via the new notes. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, or closing date is stated as it is a debt tender. The filing includes a leverage ratio disclosure for potential investors. Watch for the proration and settlement mechanics of the tender and the pricing of the new notes relative to market conditions.
